name: Skim
description: A nineteen-year-old woman, a scrappy, quick-footed skimboarder who sings fast surf-punk.
build: A small, wiry adult build: narrow shoulders, a flat torso and quick thin arms and legs, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Sun-browned skin with a scatter of bold dark freckles across the nose, bright green eyes under thick dark brows, a snub nose and a wide mouth.
hair: A messy chin-length shag of salt-bleached blonde hair with dark roots, choppy and windblown.
outfit: A fitted short-sleeved rash guard in black with one wide bold electric-lime band across the chest; baggy royal-blue board shorts to the knee with a wide bold black side panel; a black sweatband on the character-left wrist; bare feet with sand on them. Her head is bare.
performance_style: Twitchy and ready: feet staggered, weight on the balls of the feet, knees bent a little. Both arms loose and slightly out from the body, the character-right and character-left hands open, fingers spread for balance and visible. Head forward, a scrappy crooked smile.
location: The shallow shore break on a bright afternoon: glassy wet sand shining to the bottom of the frame, a thin sheet of wave water sliding up, a lifeguard tower on stilts behind, and gulls against a clear sky.
recognition_cues: a black rash guard with a wide lime band
avoid: a skimboard in the key art

sing.intent: Surf-punk vocal loop: the mic in the character-right hand jammed to the mouth, she stomps quick feet in place and throws the character-left hand open forward on each shout, then returns to the ready stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief startle at a loud beach sound: the shoulders jump, the torso draws back and both open hands rise to chest height, then she settles back into the opening stance. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: step the feet a little wider, bring the character-left forearm across the chest with the character-right hand open at the hip, and hold a steady grounded finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: she sprints in, skids on the wet sand with arms out for balance, and lands in the ready stance.
animations.victory: One-shot finish: she hops twice on quick feet, kicks one heel up behind, throws the character-left fist overhead with an open-mouthed yell and holds.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: she stays on her feet while the energy drains out: the shoulders drop, both open hands hang limp at her sides, and her head hangs low with the chin toward the chest. She holds a standing, visibly deflated finish. She remains standing on both feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, or going to the ground. Do not imply impact, injury, or an opponent.
